description: Implementation of the Normal (Gaussian) distribution, providing methods for probability density, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, sampling, and parameter access.

classes.name: NormalDistribution
classes.description: This class models the normal (Gaussian) distribution with specified mean and standard deviation, providing methods for density calculation, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, and sampling.

methods.name: getMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Computes the probability density function value at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the density at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability up to a specified value.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the quantile function (inverse of CDF) for a probability.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability that a random variable falls within a given interval.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the numerical mean of the distribution (same as mean).

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (negative infinity).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the support lower bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the support upper bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is connected (true).

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution.
